name: Spendline API
description:
Spendline is the financial control layer for production AI spend. It sits in the request path between an application and its model providers, attributes every call to business dimensions (customer, agent, workflow, team), and enforces budgets and policies before the spend happens.

**Mechanism.** Request-path proxy. Applications change their provider base URL to Spendline and keep their own provider API keys. Attribution travels as HTTP headers.

**Differentiator.** Financial control, not engineering observability. Spendline blocks spend before it occurs (HTTP 402), keeps an append-only ledger suitable for finance, and closes the month like any other COGS line.

## Base URL rules (the most common integration mistake)

- OpenAI SDK and every OpenAI-compatible client: `https://www.spendline.ai/v1`: **with** `/v1`.
- Anthropic SDK: `https://www.spendline.ai`: **without** `/v1`. The SDK appends `/v1/messages` itself.

That asymmetry is real. Do not "fix" one to match the other.

## Two credentials, two headers

- The application's own provider key travels in `Authorization: Bearer` (OpenAI-compatible)
  or `x-api-key` (Anthropic). Spendline forwards it upstream unchanged.
- The Spendline key travels in `x-spendline-key` and is consumed by Spendline.

## Not proxied

Embeddings, image generation, audio, and vector search are not in the request path.
Leave those calls pointed directly at the provider.

## Human authorization

Billing, payment methods, provider-key storage, budget raises/deletes and month
close/reopen are deliberately absent from this spec: they require a human. See
https://www.spendline.ai/agents/onboarding.md
